description:
SURFACED by the fz-ose (re-scoped) audit. token_payload::decode_token (token_payload.rs:~144) stamps every decoded token with Span::new(SourceId(0), start, end) — byte offsets are the token's REAL offsets (round-tripped verbatim) but the code_id is a PLACEHOLDER.

fz-ose fixed this ONLY for the @spec-fragment path, via FragmentCursor::current_span (quoted_function.rs:~1517) which rebuilds the span with the real ctx.code_id. But two other consumers of decode_tokens output still keep the raw SourceId(0) spans:
- quoted_type_expr_body (quoted_function.rs:~1188, @type bodies + non-@spec type ascriptions) -> TypeExprBody
- required_map_tokens / required_map_list_tokens / optional_map_keyword_tokens (quoted_function.rs:~1653)

These feed TypeExprBody, consumed by type_expr.rs (parse_type_expr/parse_type_def_body) whose TypeExprError.span is built directly from token.span (type_expr.rs:~112,136) with NO code_id correction. Surfaces live: source_publish.rs:457 + :1470 emit Diagnostic::error(RESOLVE_TYPE_ALIAS, ..., error.span) with error.span.code_id == SourceId(0).

IMPACT: masked in single-file compiles (the first submitted file typically IS code id 0 — which is why every existing single-file fixture never caught it). In a MULTI-FILE compile, a malformed @type or type annotation in the 2nd+ file renders its diagnostic pointing at byte offsets in the WRONG file (file 0's source). Pre-existing; not introduced by fz-ose.

FIX (correct-by-construction, preferred): thread a real code_id into decode_token/decode_tokens itself, so every decoded token carries the right SourceId — this OBSOLETES the per-call-site FragmentCursor rebuild patch too (fold it away). ALT: apply the rebuild-with-real-code_id pattern at type_expr.rs's TypeExprError.span construction sites.

VERIFY: a MULTI-FILE fixture with a malformed @type/type-annotation in the non-first file surfaces a RESOLVE_TYPE_ALIAS diagnostic pointing at the correct file (right SourceId, right offsets). Confirm FragmentCursor's rebuild can be deleted if decode_token is fixed at source. lib+matrix green.

comments.text: LANDED at 49126e966 (folded from wt/b5-3sb f159bd82c). Threaded the real code_id into decode_token/decode_tokens at source; every one of the 8 call sites now stamps the correct SourceId. DELETED the fz-ose FragmentCursor::current_span rebuild patch (its code_id field + rebuild closure) — now redundant since token.span carries the right code id at construction (fold win: patch removed, not layered). Test: port_resolve_test.rs::malformed_type_alias_in_second_file_points_at_that_files_span — real multi-file production path, asserts both the correct SourceId AND the byte offsets bracketing the malformed comma; proven non-vacuous (reverting the fix fails Id(0) vs Id(2)). lib 1235/0/9 in-worktree, 1238/0/6 on the folded branch. Adversarial audit: SOUND, no blocker; all risk areas (call-site completeness, FragmentCursor deletion safety, @spec path still correct, test validity, single-file no-regression, conversion idiom pre-existing) cleared. Audit surfaced an UNCONFIRMED, non-regression follow-up (cross-code macro-spliced token spans) -> fz-s2b.

title: token_payload::decode_token leaks SourceId(0) into @type/type-ascription diagnostics (wrong file in multi-file compiles)
